name: CMD CONTINUE
description: Brainless session resume — recover plan state and execute
content: CMD CONTINUE: update_plan → execute → verify → iterate. Complete autonomously. `update_plan` `exec`

name: CMD EXECUTE
description: Override hesitation — PLAN/EXECUTE/RED-TEAM/VERIFY/ITERATE with WBS codes
content: CMD EXECUTE: PLAN: update_plan with WBS-coded items. Pre-flight first. EXECUTE: One phase at a time. Verify each phase. Use subagents. RED-TEAM: Review output adversarially. VERIFY: Every done claim requires tool call same-turn. ITERATE: Re-plan, zero deferred = done. Store outcomes to memory. `update_plan` `exec` `subagent_orchestrator` `memory_remember`

name: CMD RED TEAM
description: Direct 5-adversary audit — report findings, do NOT modify anything
content: CMD RED TEAM: 5-adversary direct audit (Accuracy/Completeness/Dependency/Novelty/Status). READ-ONLY — report findings, do NOT modify. `skill_view` `read` `exec`

name: CMD RED TEAM SUB
description: Parallel subagent red-team review — dispatch 3-5 reviewers, aggregate report
content: CMD RED TEAM SUB: subagent_orchestrator(run, parallel) → 3-5 reviewer slots (Accuracy/Completeness/Dependency). Wait → report aggregate. Do NOT modify. Fallback = direct audit if truncated. `subagent_orchestrator` `skill_view`

name: CMD RESEARCH
description: Load research skill → Phase 1 Due Diligence — paper discovery, KG query, gap analysis
content: CMD RESEARCH: skill_view research → Phase 0 FIRST (net-new projects ONLY: WBS resolve from D1 program_registry → branch res/paper/<slug> → PROJECT-PLAN.md → lock core claim (P6) → commit/tag/push; existing projects skip) → Phase 1 (Due Diligence): query_graph(stats) → search_papers → search_papers_enriched → recall_facts → gap analysis → update_plan with WBS codes. HARD GATE: Phase 1 MUST NOT begin until Phase 0 committed. `skill_view` `query_graph` `search_papers` `exec`

name: CMD SKILLS UPDATE
description: Full kaizen cycle — red-team skills audit, update skills, closeout
content: CMD SKILLS UPDATE: EXECUTE RED TEAM SKILLS AUDIT. EXECUTE KAIZEN SKILLS UPDATES. LOAD UPDATED SKILLS. UPDATE KAIZEN. PLAN UPDATED KAIZEN EXECUTE. EXECUTE UPDATED KAIZEN. PLAN ITEMS TO EXECUTE. UPDATE PLAN WITH ALL ITEMS. EXECUTE PLAN WITH ALL ITEMS SYSTEMATICALLY. ITERATE PLAN UPDATES/EXECUTION. `update_plan` `exec`

name: CMD PUBLISH
description: Skip to research Phase 5 — paper is drafted, publish to Zenodo + D1 + deploy
content: CMD PUBLISH: skill_view research → Phase 5 pipeline: pandoc PDF build → Zenodo deposit (deposit API, 3 files mandatory: .md/.pdf/.html) → publish → verify DOI live (curl -sI) → D1 living-paper insert → deploy papers.qnfo.org → verify deployment. `skill_view` `exec` `search_papers`

name: CMD CLOSEOUT
description: Session closeout — git verify, audit tasks, D1 qnfo-audit.handoffs, wbs_state, tape, cleanup, continuation
content: CMD CLOSEOUT: verify git clean → audit deferred tasks → memory_remember(category=task_outcome) → insert D1 qnfo-audit.handoffs → update wbs_state → tape_search → cleanup temp files → generate CMD CONTINUE handoff. `memory_remember` `exec` `tape_search`

name: CMD DEPLOY
description: Cloudflare infrastructure deployment — Workers, Pages, D1, R2, verify live
content: CMD DEPLOY: skill_view cloudflare → wrangler deploy → verify Workers live (curl) → verify Pages build → verify D1 (SELECT) → verify R2 (download-back) → git push origin. `skill_view` `exec` `wrangler`
